pending: Confirmation ka result pakka nahi hai. Fields locked hain; Confirm se yahi entry safely retry karo, stock do baar nahi judega.
entryHint: Product ka naam aur quantity bolo. Purane product ka stock badhao ya yahin naya product review karke jodo.
newProductHint: Naam, selling unit aur price check karo. Confirm karne par product aur stock saath save honge.
name: Product Ka Naam
productDetails: Product ka naam, sahi unit aur selling price daalo (2 decimal tak).
duplicateProduct: Yeh product pehle se hai. Catalogue se chuno.
priceHint: Product ki ek unit ki price. 0 tabhi daalo jab wahi sahi price ho.
title: Bolkar Stock Jodo
subtitle: Bolo, check karo, phir stock jodo. Confirmation tumhare haath mein.
history: Voice se jode stock ka itihaas
rulesHint: Browser awaaz ko text banata hai. Product matching rules aur aliases se hoti hai, live AI service se nahi.
privacy: Browser audio apni speech service ko bhej sakta hai. DukaanSet raw audio record ya save nahi karta. Agree ho tab start karo; typing bhi chalegi.
listening: Sun rahe hain — aaram se bolo
processing: Tumhare shabd check ho rahe hain
transcriptHint: Command type, edit ya paste karo. Review se stock save nahi hota.
placeholder: 4 doodh packet, 2 kilo dal, 5 kilo pyaz…
sampleHint: Demo simulator · sample text, live speech nahi
unsaved: Sirf draft — stock abhi update nahi hua.
offline: Internet nahi hai. Draft iss device par hai; confirm se pehle connect karo.
restored: Iss business ka unsaved draft mil gaya.
storage: Iss browser mein draft recovery available nahi. Confirm tak page khula rakho.
selectResolvedHint: Unresolved rows iss entry se alag hongi aur naye unsaved draft mein rahengi.
noHistory: Abhi voice stock entry nahi hai.
repeatHint: Repeat se naya draft banta hai. Stock badalne se pehle review aur confirm karo.
unknown: Product ka naam aur unit bolein ya likhein.
ambiguous: Kai products match ho sakte hain. Sahi product chuno.
quantity: Positive quantity daalo, decimal ke baad maximum 3 digits.
conversion: Iss product ke liye yeh conversion configured nahi hai.
whole: Iss product mein whole pieces, packets ya boxes chahiye.
limit: Quantity allowed range ya precision se bahar hai.
correctionIssue: Correction clear nahi tha. Product aur quantity chuno.
missing: Highlighted quantity, unit ya rate poori karein.
unsupported: Yahan speech recognition available nahi. Type karo ya manually item jodo.
permission: Microphone permission nahi mili. Browser settings mein allow karo ya type karo.
audio: Microphone nahi mila. Device check karo ya type karo.
network: Speech service connect nahi hui. Draft safe hai; phir try karo ya type karo.
silence: Awaaz nahi mili. Phir start karo ya type karo.
language: Browser mein yeh spoken language available nahi. Dusra option lo ya type karo.
aborted: Recording ruki. Captured words check karo ya type karo.
speechError: Speech recognition ruk gayi. Words check karo ya typing use karo.
saveError: Stock confirm nahi hua. Draft badalne se pehle history check karo, phir same entry retry karo.
readHistoryError: History load nahi hui. Connect karke phir try karo.
support: Speech support browser aur device par depend karta hai. Words galat aayein toh edit karo ya type karo.
transcriptDuplicate: Yeh words pehle review hue hain. Edit karo ya nayi correction bolo.
resetHint: Tumhare sabhi isolated demo businesses ka sample data dobara banega. Real businesses nahi badlenge.
demoResetError: Demo reset nahi hua. Current workspace available hai.
unknownError: Kaam poora nahi hua. Retry se pehle history check karo.
shortHint: Bolo kitna stock aaya. Ek baar review, saath mein save.
requiredRate: Naya product banane ke liye selling rate dein. Price guess nahi hota.
priceMeaning: Yeh total purchase cost hai ya per-unit selling rate?
